name: enargy-root
description: Blockchain-Powered Smart Energy Meter - Ecosystem Root Launcher

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix blockchain && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix backend && npm audit --prefix blockchain && npm audit --prefix frontend
scripts.audit:json: npm audit --prefix backend --json > backend/npm-audit.json; npm audit --prefix blockchain --json > blockchain/npm-audit.json; npm audit --prefix frontend --json > frontend/npm-audit.json
